summary: HSBC Holdings plc, via its Form 6-K, disclosed the daily repurchase of ordinary shares under its buy-back programme announced 5 August 2026, executed by BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC as principal. On 12 August 2026, HSBC purchased 1,370,000 shares on UK venues at a VWAP of US$15.2941, and 345,600 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$161.2391 VWAP. Total consideration since programme commencement is US$96.4m for 4,680,400 shares. Shares are purchased for cancellation, reducing issued share capital. What to watch: continued buy-back execution pace and impact on earnings per share.
